main.description: A page of what one of the caller's own instances wrote, redacted on its host. Customers only.

deploymentId.description: Bound the page to this deployment's window, read from the host it ran on.

since.description: Narrows the window; never widens a deployment's.

until.description: Narrows the window; never widens a deployment's.

cursor.description: The cursor a previous page returned, with the same direction.

direction.description: backward: the newest lines before until or cursor. forward: the oldest after since or cursor.

lines.description: Oldest first, whichever way the page was read.

cursor.description: Pass with the same direction for the next page. Absent when there are no lines.

more.description: Whether more lines lie beyond this page in its direction.

oldestAvailable.description: The oldest line the host still holds, on a page read without a cursor.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: An id is not a UUID, or a time, cursor, direction or limit is malformed or out of range.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such instance or deployment, or either is not the caller's. These are indistinguishable.

errors.name: NotADeployment
errors.description: The change started no container (a stop, a deletion or a domain-only update), so it has no logs of its own.

errors.name: LogsUnavailable
errors.description: The host the logs are on is not answering, or no longer holds the instance.

errors.name: LogsBusy
errors.description: Too many log reads are running for this instance or its host. Try again shortly.

errors.name: LogsTimeout
errors.description: Reading the logs took too long. Narrow the time range.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a HappyProto customer, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.

message.description: With the instance's secrets and anything shaped like a credential replaced by [redacted].

window.description: The deployment's window, when deploymentId was given.

until.description: Absent while the deployment is the newest.
